phase: Phase 42 — Data Augmentation + Multi-Scale + Resolution Robustness

model_selection.selection_criterion: Lowest Copenhagen Val MAE among configs with Test improvement over A

verdict_explanation.MLP_PeakRecovery: Config B (Geometric) shows marginal improvement in zero-shot New York MAE (-0.065m) and skyscraper MAE (-0.275m). Not strong enough to replace Phase 29 on numeric grounds alone.
verdict_explanation.UNet_Footprint: Geometric augmentation (B) and Multi-scale (D) both show substantial IoU improvements (+22.9% and +37.6%). This is architecturally significant for downstream 3D building reconstruction.
verdict_explanation.Resolution_Degradation: Resolution degradation training provides no meaningful benefit. 8x factor slightly increases error.
verdict_explanation.RGB_Photometric: Adding photometric augmentation (C) consistently hurts numeric metrics vs geometric-only (B).
verdict_explanation.Multi_scale_Crop_MLP: Config D hurts Copenhagen stability and increases Test MAE, NOT recommended for PeakRecoveryMLP.
verdict_explanation.Multi_scale_UNet: Config D massively improves Recall (89.2%) for building detection, which directly benefits downstream 3D.

recommendation: Keep Phase 29 PeakRecoveryMLP. Adopt UNet Config D (Geometric+Photometric+MultiScale) for footprint improvement to improve 3D quality.
